name: Grade 10 English
description: A comprehensive English language course tailored for O/L (Ordinary Level) students in Sri Lanka. Covers grammar, reading comprehension, letter and essay writing, poetry analysis, and exam technique aligned with the Sri Lankan O/L syllabus.

name: Grade 11 English
description: An advanced English course for Grade 11 students preparing for the Sri Lankan O/L examination. Focuses on higher-order writing skills, literary analysis, formal and informal communication, and past paper practice to maximise exam performance.

name: Spoken English
description: A practical conversational English course designed for all age groups in Sri Lanka. Builds confidence in everyday speaking, pronunciation, vocabulary, and interpersonal communication through interactive exercises, role-plays, and guided discussions.
